# Projects

<!-- auto-generated by cmd/docgen — do not edit -->

Jira projects are containers for issues. Each project has a key (e.g. `MYPROJ`),
a name, a type (software, business, service management), and a lead.

## jira project list

List all accessible Jira projects.

**Alias:** `ls`

### Usage

```
jira project list [flags]
```

### Flags

| Flag | Short | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--type` | | Filter by project type: `software`, `business`, `service_desk` |
| `--category` | | Filter by project category name |
| `--limit` | `-L` | Maximum projects to display (default 50, 0 = all) |

### Inherited Flags

| Flag | Short | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--context` | `-c` | Active Jira context name |
| `--json` | | Output in JSON format |
| `--yaml` | | Output in YAML format |
| `--jq` | | Apply a jq expression to JSON output |

### Examples

```bash
jira project list
jira project list --type software
jira project list --limit 0 --json    # all projects as JSON
```

## jira project view

Display details for a project.

### Usage

```
jira project view [project-key] [flags]
```

### Flags

| Flag | Short | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--project` | `-p` | Project key |
| `--web` | `-w` | Open in browser |

### Examples

```bash
jira project view
jira project view MYPROJ
jira project view MYPROJ --json
jira project view MYPROJ --web
```

---

## jira project create

Create a new Jira project.

### Usage

```
jira project create [flags]
```

### Flags

| Flag | Short | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--name` | `-n` | Project name |
| `--key` | `-k` | Project key (uppercase, e.g. `MYPROJ`) |
| `--type` | | Project type: `scrum`, `kanban`, `business`, `service_desk` |
| `--lead` | | Lead user account ID or `me` |
| `--description` | `-d` | Project description |
| `--template` | | Project template (varies by Jira version) |

### Examples

```bash
jira project create --name "My Project" --key MYPROJ --type scrum --lead me
jira project create --name "Support" --key SUPPORT --type service_desk
```

## jira project components

List components defined in a project.

### Usage

```
jira project components [project-key] [flags]
```

### Examples

```bash
jira project components MYPROJ
jira project components MYPROJ --json
```

---

## jira project versions

List versions (fix versions) defined in a project.

### Usage

```
jira project versions [project-key] [flags]
```

### Flags

| Flag | Short | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--released` | | Show only released versions |
| `--unreleased` | | Show only unreleased versions |

### Examples

```bash
jira project versions MYPROJ
jira project versions MYPROJ --unreleased --json
```

---

## jira project issuetypes

List issue types available in a project.

### Usage

```
jira project issuetypes [project-key] [flags]
```

### Examples

```bash
jira project issuetypes MYPROJ
jira project issuetypes MYPROJ --json
```
